storyCards.headline: Rock Of Ages: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Def Leppard's "Rock Of Ages" reached #16 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Rock of Ages" is a song by Def Leppard from their 1983 album Pyromania.

When issued as a single in the United States, the song reached #16 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart and #19 on the Cash Box Top 100.

It also hit #1 on the Top Tracks Rock chart.

The song peaked at #16 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #16 on the Hot 100.
